_note: Synthetic recorded replies for the AC3.2.1 demo walk. Paraphrased from the pack's own node content, never guideline text. One reply per section, chosen by the section tag in the request. The node-ID replies serve the follow-up turn after anti-TNF failure (N46, N72, N99, N103) and the day-3 review walk that enters Tier 3 (N53, N95); node-ID replies are ordered so the follow-up still matches first. Care-loop cards (section id care_step): the first entry serves the pre-biologic screens, the second is an empty card.

replies.text: {"lines": [{"text": "Screen for latent tuberculosis before the first dose.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N110"], "claims": []}, {"text": "Screen for hepatitis B before the first dose, and take specialist advice if the result is positive.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N111"], "claims": []}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Start here: after anti-TNF failure, check drug levels and antibodies, then change to another drug class (Tier 3).", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N46"], "claims": [{"kind": "tier", "value": "3"}]}, {"text": "Ustekinumab starts with one weight-based intravenous induction dose, then 90 mg under the skin every 8 weeks.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N54"], "claims": [{"kind": "drug", "value": "ustekinumab"}, {"kind": "dose", "value": "90", "unit": "mg"}]}, {"text": "Vedolizumab 300 mg is infused at weeks 0, 2 and 6, then every 8 weeks.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N57"], "claims": [{"kind": "drug", "value": "vedolizumab"}, {"kind": "dose", "value": "300", "unit": "mg"}, {"kind": "frequency", "value": "weeks 0, 2 and 6, then every 8 weeks"}]}, {"text": "Tofacitinib, an oral JAK inhibitor, is started at 10 mg twice daily for 8 weeks of induction.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N58"], "claims": [{"kind": "drug", "value": "tofacitinib"}, {"kind": "dose", "value": "10", "unit": "mg"}, {"kind": "frequency", "value": "twice daily"}]}, {"text": "A second anti-TNF is mainly an option after a loss of response with low levels or antibodies.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N46"], "claims": []}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Entry point is Tier 3 rescue therapy: without an adequate response by day 3, rescue therapy is the step taken now.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N42"], "claims": [{"kind": "tier", "value": "3"}]}, {"text": "Infliximab 5 mg/kg intravenously at weeks 0, 2 and 6, then every 8 weeks.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N53"], "claims": [{"kind": "drug", "value": "infliximab"}, {"kind": "dose", "value": "5", "unit": "mg/kg"}, {"kind": "frequency", "value": "weeks 0, 2 and 6, then every 8 weeks"}]}, {"text": "Ustekinumab starts with one weight-based intravenous induction dose, then 90 mg under the skin every 8 weeks.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N54"], "claims": [{"kind": "drug", "value": "ustekinumab"}, {"kind": "dose", "value": "90", "unit": "mg"}]}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Check the anti-TNF trough level and antibodies; a trough of at least 5 ug/mL is the suggested target.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N72"], "claims": [{"kind": "threshold", "value": "5", "unit": "ug/mL"}]}, {"text": "On the new treatment, aim for a faecal calprotectin of 250 ug/g or below.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N83"], "claims": [{"kind": "threshold", "value": "250", "unit": "ug/g"}]}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Before a JAK inhibitor, review the risk of blood clots and heart events, and shingles vaccination.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N103"], "claims": []}, {"text": "With no response to steroids after anti-TNF failure, arrange an early surgical review to discuss colectomy.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N99"], "claims": []}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Before a JAK inhibitor, review the risk of blood clots and heart events, and shingles vaccination.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N103"], "claims": []}, {"text": "Steroids are only a short bridge until the new maintenance treatment works, then they are tapered off.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N102"], "claims": []}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Send stool tests for bacterial pathogens and C. difficile toxin before escalating.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N94"], "claims": []}, {"text": "With no improvement within 4 to 7 days of rescue therapy, discuss colectomy with a colorectal surgeon.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N95"], "claims": []}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Visible blood in loose stools is a key presenting feature to assess.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N1"], "claims": []}, {"text": "A haemoglobin below 10.5 g/dL counts as a marker of systemic toxicity.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N3"], "claims": [{"kind": "threshold", "value": "10.5", "unit": "g/dL"}]}, {"text": "Faecal calprotectin above 50 ug/g supports looking for bowel inflammation.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N5"], "claims": [{"kind": "threshold", "value": "50", "unit": "ug/g"}]}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "The working diagnosis is suspected inflammatory bowel disease.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N10"], "claims": [{"kind": "diagnosis", "value": "inflammatory bowel disease"}]}, {"text": "The results refine this to ulcerative colitis, a continuous inflammation that starts in the rectum.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N11"], "claims": [{"kind": "diagnosis", "value": "ulcerative colitis"}]}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Stool culture and C. difficile testing rule out an infective cause.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N20"], "claims": [{"kind": "test", "value": "stool culture"}]}, {"text": "Ileocolonoscopy with biopsies establishes the diagnosis and separates the two main forms.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N21"], "claims": [{"kind": "test", "value": "ileocolonoscopy"}]}, {"text": "The Montreal extent grades the disease from E1 to E3.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N22"], "claims": []}, {"text": "Truelove and Witts grading sets the activity as mild, moderate or severe.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N23"], "claims": []}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Extent E3 places this as extensive ulcerative colitis, a pancolitis.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N32"], "claims": [{"kind": "diagnosis", "value": "extensive ulcerative colitis"}]}, {"text": "Severe activity makes it acute severe ulcerative colitis, which needs admission.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N34"], "claims": [{"kind": "diagnosis", "value": "acute severe ulcerative colitis"}]}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Entry point is Tier 2: intravenous corticosteroids in hospital.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N41"], "claims": [{"kind": "tier", "value": "2"}]}, {"text": "Hydrocortisone 100 mg intravenously four times daily.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N51"], "claims": [{"kind": "drug", "value": "hydrocortisone"}, {"kind": "dose", "value": "100", "unit": "mg"}, {"kind": "frequency", "value": "four times daily"}]}, {"text": "Methylprednisolone 60 mg intravenously once daily is the alternative regimen.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N52"], "claims": [{"kind": "drug", "value": "methylprednisolone"}, {"kind": "dose", "value": "60", "unit": "mg"}, {"kind": "frequency", "value": "once daily"}]}, {"text": "Without an adequate response by day 3, Tier 3 rescue therapy is the next step.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N42"], "claims": [{"kind": "tier", "value": "3"}]}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Record stool frequency daily; more than 8 per day on day 3 makes colectomy likely.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N70"], "claims": [{"kind": "threshold", "value": "8", "unit": "per day"}]}, {"text": "Check CRP during treatment; above 45 mg/L on day 3 also predicts colectomy.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N71"], "claims": [{"kind": "threshold", "value": "45", "unit": "mg/L"}]}, {"text": "More than 8 per day on day 3 means no response to Tier 2.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N80"], "claims": [{"kind": "threshold", "value": "8", "unit": "per day"}, {"kind": "tier", "value": "2"}]}]}
{"lines": [{"text": "No specific diet is proven to control the disease; screen for malnutrition and advise individually.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N60"], "claims": []}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Send stool tests for bacterial pathogens and C. difficile toxin before escalating.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N94"], "claims": []}, {"text": "Colonic dilatation with systemic toxicity needs urgent joint medical and surgical review.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N90"], "claims": []}, {"text": "Give low-molecular-weight heparin prophylaxis in hospital unless contraindicated.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N91"], "claims": []}, {"text": "Toxic megacolon that does not settle, perforation or major bleeding call for emergency colectomy.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N96"], "claims": []}]}

{"lines": [{"text": "Infectious colitis can mimic this presentation and must be excluded.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N13"], "claims": [{"kind": "diagnosis", "value": "infectious colitis"}]}, {"text": "Stool culture and C. difficile testing is the test for this branch.", "nodeIds": ["IBD-N20"], "claims": [{"kind": "test", "value": "stool culture"}]}]}
